subject: use negate flag parser in ft.info parser (#524)
reason: Pure refactor with no behaviour change: the diff replaces two inline lambda parsers for FT.INFO's ALLSHARDS and INCONSISTENT keywords with the GENERATE_NEGATED_FLAG_PARSER macro, which expands (vmsdk/src/command_parser.h:211-216) to an identical lambda that sets the same field (enable_partial_results / require_consistency) to false and returns OkStatus, consuming no arguments. Parsing semantics, accepted syntax, and FT.INFO replies are unchanged on both builds, so a compared sequence could never show a difference and no fault path is touched.
